items.claim: CFF/cmap checks skipped for WOFF input (A, part a)
items.note: A WOFF face is now unpacked to the sfnt it wraps before anything reads it.

items.claim: CFF check runs only under an `OTTO` signature (A, part b)
items.note: The check now runs whenever opentype.js will read `CFF `, meaning the font has no glyf+loca pair.

items.claim: WOFF face loses kerning behind a GPOS Extension lookup
items.note: Same fix as the WOFF checks; the WOFF face now kerns exactly as the TTF does. The same change also gives a WOFF face an embedding, so `fontEmbedding` no longer answers null for it. The existing test that expected null now expects the unpacked sfnt.
The memo now clears once it holds 4096 pairs.

items.claim: loadFontOutlines / fontEmbedding report a replaced registration
items.note: `loadFontOutlines` now waits on whatever registration holds the variant when the load settles, and answers null if the face was dropped. `domFace.test.ts` and the `outlineRegistry.pbt` model were updated to this behavior.

items.claim: Local variable font registers default outlines under every named instance
items.note: The parser now rejects a font with `fvar` when the PostScript name asked for is not its nameID 6, the default instance's. This was a behavior call I made myself; it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Thunk or Blob source read twice when DOM text asks first
items.note: The read is shared through the slot, dropped once the load settles, and dropped on failure so a later call can retry.

A pair now takes one LangSys's lookups: `latn`, then `DFLT`, then the rest, using the first whose lookups cover the pair. This was also my call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`, though the entry landed in commit 52ae7aacab rather than this one. Inter's kerning is unchanged: 0 of 4141 kerned pairs differ.
